answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 57360 Country: India Title: Removal of naval and underarms hairs Question: My question to you is that whether I can use a trimmer (trim machine) to remove my underarms and navel hairs instead of a razor. I have heard that only a razor must be used and a trimmer is not allowed. So please guide me whether I can use a trimmer or not? Answer ID: 57360 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 286/298/N=03/1436) It is lawful to use a trimmer for armpit and navel hair. However, it is better to pluck the hair of the armpits if you can bear it or you are addicted to it. However, it is better to remove the navel hair for men. So if the trimmer cannot shave it then it is better to use razor or use the trimmer at zero no so that it takes the shape of razor. قوله : "ويستحب حلق عانته"، قال فى الهندية: ويبتدئ من تحت السرة، ولو عالج بالنورة يجوز كذا فى الغرائب، ..... قوله: وتنظيف بدنه" بنحو إزالة الشعر من إبطيه، ويجوز فيه الحق، وانتف أولى الخ (رد المحتار 9:583 مطبوعه مكته زكريا ديوبند) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
